fock_dimension.description: Fock dimension of the even sector at QP cutoff 2

basis_states.description: Static basis size $K$ of the Floquet-cutoff study

strong_S.description: Quasienergy of $S$ at $A=1.5$ with the reference cutoff

strong_Sstar.description: Quasienergy of $S^*$ at $A=1.5$ with the reference cutoff

converged_harmonics.description: Smallest $M$ with both residual bounds below $10^{-6}$

decades_per_harmonic.description: Decrease of the error per harmonic, in decades, from $M=2$ to 7

max_error_over_bound.description: Largest ratio of the actual error to the residual bound

propagator_deviation.description: Distance of the propagator quasienergies from the Sambe reference

propagator_step_error.description: Estimated time-step error of the propagator

stark_shift.description: AC Stark shift $\varepsilon_S-E_S$ in the Fock space

basis_error_large.description: Static-basis error at the largest $K$ below the Fock dimension

max_error_over_fock_residual.description: Largest ratio of the static-basis error to the Fock-space residual

shift_below_2.description: AC Stark shift of $S$ at $\Omega=1$, two level pairs

shift_below_4.description: AC Stark shift of $S$ at $\Omega=1$, four level pairs

shift_below_8.description: AC Stark shift of $S$ at $\Omega=1$, eight level pairs

min_weight_above_2.description: Smallest static weight of $S$ above the threshold, two level pairs

min_weight_above_4.description: Smallest static weight of $S$ above the threshold, four level pairs

min_weight_above_8.description: Smallest static weight of $S$ above the threshold, eight level pairs
